name: marquee-along-svg-path
title: Marquee Along SVG Path
description: A marquee of image cards that travels along an invisible curving path, each card rotating to follow the line. It slows on hover, reacts to scroll and can be dragged.
use: A portfolio or hero wants a distinctive, looping image strip that is not a straight row.
avoid: Cards overlap on an arbitrary curve, so many photos stay partly hidden and captions are hard to place.
a11y: Cards keep auto-moving with no reduced-motion check and no keyboard control; only pointer dragging changes the motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single wavy line runs across a black field, lined with small rounded photo tiles that overlap slightly. Every tile is turned to follow the local slope, so the strip reads as a flowing ribbon under a small heading.
behaves: The photos slide continuously along the curve and wrap from the end back to the start. Hovering slows them, dragging tugs the whole ribbon, and cards near the back tuck behind their neighbours.
customise: Any children plus path data, viewBox, size, path visibility, base velocity, direction, easing, hover slowdown, scroll velocity, drag settings, repeat count and z-index rolling are props.
weight: moderate: A motion frame loop updates offset-distance for around twenty tiles every frame.
